Creeps and Curses V.3.1

Major Cursed Technique. Example technique for sorcerers and NPCs (GM approval).

Your unarmed strikes deal 1d8 slashing damage or bludgeoning damage. Additionally, you automatically deal twice as much damage against objects and structures with your unarmed strikes or melee weapon attacks. Any cursed techniques you use against such targets deal maximum damage.

Stone Cutting Strike

When you attack with an unarmed strike or melee weapon, you can spend 2 cursed energy to deal an additional 10 damage of the attack’s base damage type on a hit. This later increases to 15.

Swift Fury

As a bonus action for 2 cursed energy, you can make two unarmed strikes or melee weapon attacks.
